result.title: GLARE: Generating Listening Heads with Appropriate Reactions
result.comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://github.com/lzk901372/glare
result.summary: While talking head generation has advanced rapidly, generating natural listener behavior in dyadic conversations, which know when to react, how to react, and with what type of response, remains underexplored. Existing dyadic datasets lack fine-grained listener reaction annotations, and prevailing evaluation metrics inherited from talking-head and video generation measure visual realism rather than whether a listener reacted appropriately. We address these gaps along three aspects. First, we curate a listening-head-specific dataset built from RealTalk and Seamless Interaction, comprising approximately 147 hours of paired speaker-listener videos with 64,557 event-level reaction annotations across six categories: nodding, head shaking, smiling, laughing, frowning, and surprised. Second, we introduce an audio-driven baseline built on a flow-matching transformer, namely GLARE, with prosody conditioning derived from Qwen2-Audio and a temporal reaction loss that explicitly supervises frame-wise reactions. Third, we propose a reaction-oriented evaluation protocol that jointly measures reaction occurrence (R-F1), temporal alignment (R-tIoU), asymmetric temporal deviation (R-ATD), and reaction-region visual quality (R-FID), giving a more behaviorally grounded assessment than visual-quality-only metrics. Experiment results show consistent gains over prior listening-head methods in both visual fidelity and reaction-level metrics, suggesting that reaction-aware data, modeling, and evaluation are critical for natural listening behavior.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作面向双人对话中的「倾听者」头部生成，构建了约 147 小时、含 6.4 万余条事件级反应标注的说话人—倾听者配对数据集，提出基于 flow-matching transformer 的音频驱动基线（含韵律条件与时序反应损失），并给出反应发生、时序对齐与时序偏差等行为导向的评价协议。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时反应、如何反应、反应类型」的事件级监督与反应发生/时序评价，可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策、停止与证据获取时机的问题表述和评价指标设计形成类比，可供核查；但主要属头部生成任务，与多模态推理状态无直接联系。
